ranks: Marvel Super Heroes (MSH, 2026-06-26): top 50% by EDHREC rank, its next 60; with teamwork built (rule 702.194)

authored.name: Tony Stark // The Invincible Iron Man

blocked.name: Taskmaster, Mercenary Mimic
blocked.why: become-copy lasts only until end of turn and copies only a permanent; this targets a creature or a creature card in a graveyard and lasts until your next turn

blocked.name: Hawkeye, Young Avenger
blocked.why: would-deal-damage's `plus` is a fixed number; 'plus X, where X is Hawkeye's power' needs a live amount

blocked.name: Super-Soldier Serum
blocked.why: 'is a legendary Soldier in addition to its other types': no static adds a supertype

blocked.name: Super Intelligence
blocked.why: step-begins `who` is any/you/opponent only; no 'the upkeep of enchanted creature's controller' trigger, nor 'that player' for its draw

blocked.name: Iron Man Armor
blocked.why: animate can't give the creature the static 'This creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control'; a one-shot modify-pt wouldn't track the count

blocked.name: Kid Loki
blocked.why: no filter for 'creature you've put one or more +1/+1 counters on this turn'

blocked.name: Doc Samson, Super Psychiatrist
blocked.why: would-add-counter is a multiplier only; 'that many plus one of each kind' needs an addend

blocked.name: Ironheart, Clever Champion
blocked.why: improvise isn't modeled, nor granting it to noncreature spells you cast

blocked.name: The Scarlet Witch
blocked.why: CostReductionAmount has no 'this permanent's power'; reduceGeneric takes counts and aggregates over filters, none of which names the source alone

blocked.name: Captain America, Super-Soldier
blocked.why: shield counters (rule 122.1c) aren't modeled

blocked.name: Doom Reigns Supreme
blocked.why: Plan: no 'when the Nth plan counter is put on this' trigger (counters-put fires on any put, no threshold crossing); and cast-now's repeat has no 'up to two' cap.

blocked.name: Claim the Kingdom
blocked.why: Plan: no 'when the fourth plan counter is put on this enchantment' trigger; the landfall half and the reflexive indestructible counter are otherwise expressible.

blocked.name: Construct a Cosmic Cube
blocked.why: Plan: no Nth-counter trigger, and controlling an opponent during their next turn (Mindslaver) isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Namor the Sub-Mariner
blocked.why: 'Create that many' = the number of blue mana symbols in the cast spell's mana cost: no amount (or filter) counts one colour's symbols in a trigger spell's cost; the */4 Merfolk CDA alone is fine.

blocked.name: Moonstone, Harsh Mistress
blocked.why: Exiling the discarded card from the graveyard with a PLAY permission until the end of your next turn: exile's mayCast is cast-only and end-of-turn/while-exiled; impulse-exile only reads a library.

blocked.name: Attuma, Atlantean Warlord
blocked.why: 'Whenever one or more Merfolk you control attack a player' — attacks-player has no attacker filter, attacks-batch no player-only defender.

blocked.name: The Astonishing Ant-Man
blocked.why: 'Remove any number of +1/+1 counters: create that many' — removeCounter is a fixed count.

blocked.name: The Serpent Society
blocked.why: Ward—Get five poison counters: WardCost has mana/life/sacrifice/discard only.

blocked.name: Heroic Feast
blocked.why: 'choose up to that many target creatures you control' — a trigger's target count from its trigger value (life gained); any-number's max is only a number or a spell's X

blocked.name: Avengers Assemble!
blocked.why: 'if you attacked with a Hero this turn' — the attackers turn stat has no filter (the entered-a-Hero half is turn-history 'entered')

blocked.name: Baron Helmut Zemo
blocked.why: Boast cost exiles any number of black cards totalling fifteen or more {B} symbols; then casting up to three of the copies free (the connive trigger alone is authorable)

blocked.name: Invisible Woman, Sue Storm
blocked.why: 'one or more +1/+1 counters on one or more other Heroes' fires once per event; counters-put fires once per permanent, so a mass counter effect would make several Walls

blocked.name: Call Damage Control
blocked.why: the modes only choose targets and 'Return those cards' is one simultaneous move; castModal applies each mode separately, so a batched leaves-graveyard trigger (Desecrated Tomb) would fire twice

blocked.name: Black Widow, Super Spy
blocked.why: the card is already exiled by reveal-until; allow-cast-from-exile grants 'cast until end of turn' but has no 'mana of any type can be spent' (spendAs)

blocked.name: Political Triumph
blocked.why: 'When the fourth plan counter is put on this enchantment' — no trigger on the Nth counter crossing (counters-put + a self-counters intervening-if would also fire on the fifth)

blocked.name: Nick Fury, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.
blocked.why: 'If it's a double-faced card, you may transform it' — look-and-choose to the battlefield has no player choice to enter transformed
